in_arabic.name: محمد
in_arabic.meaning: محمد اسم علم مذكر معناه الحمد الكثير
in_arabic.long_meaning: محمد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الحمد الكثير، وهو مشتق من الفعل حمده، وهو اسم الرسول محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم، و يعد من أكثر الأسماء شيوعا في العالم الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: محمد
in_urdu.meaning: محمد کا مطلب ہے بہت زیادہ تعریف
in_urdu.long_meaning: محمد ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے بہت زیادہ تعریف یا প্রশংসا، یہ نام اسلامی دنیا میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ رسول اللہ محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کا نام ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name Mohammad holds great cultural significance as it is the name of the last and final Prophet of Islam, Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). He is regarded as a prophet, leader, and role model for Muslims around the world. The name Mohammad is recognized and revered in the Islamic community and beyond, as a symbol of peace, compassion, and perseverance.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mohammad holds immense significance in Islamic tradition as it symbolizes the embodiment of God's mercy, guidance, and wisdom on earth. It is believed that Allah (God) chose the name Mohammad for Prophet Muhammad as a sign of his approval and favor. The name is a constant reminder of the Prophet's mission to spread the message of Islam, and to serve as a model of conduct for Muslims to follow. This name signifies the love and devotion of Muslims towards their Prophet and their faith, and is often used as a form of invocation and spiritual expression.
